ui_preview_intro: Every shared component in @saas/ui with its variants and states. Switch the preset, color mode, shape and density to check them together. Available in development and staging only.
ui_preview_button_desc: Shadcn variants with the Fluid ladder; loading and icon slots are built in.
ui_preview_fields_desc: Single-line and multi-line fields share the border, height ladder and focus ring.
ui_preview_select_desc: Pick one option from a short list; errors are linked to the trigger.
ui_preview_combobox_desc: Type to filter a longer list; supports clearing and multiple selection.
ui_preview_choice_desc: Checkboxes for selections in a list, switches for settings that apply at once.
ui_preview_badge_desc: Short labels for status and categories, and tooltips for icon-only controls.
ui_preview_tabs_desc: Switch between views of the same content; arrow keys move between tabs.
ui_preview_dropdown_desc: Menus of actions, nested menus, checkable items and searchable lists.
ui_preview_command_desc: Search and run commands from the keyboard, inline or in a dialog.
ui_preview_dialog_desc: Dialogs for focused tasks; alert dialogs confirm destructive actions.
ui_preview_toast_desc: Short notices that disappear on their own; press F8 to reach them.
ui_preview_sidebar_desc: Grouped navigation that collapses to icons and opens as a drawer on small screens.
ui_preview_surface_desc: Containers, inline messages, dividers and scrolling regions.
ui_preview_table_desc: Server-side pagination and filters for lists.
ui_preview_form_desc: Fields validate after blur or submit; errors appear below each field.
ui_preview_icons_active_label: Icons · label on the selected tab
ui_preview_command_hint: Press ⌘K or Ctrl+K to open the command menu.
ui_preview_rename_desc: The new name is shown to everyone in the workspace.
ui_preview_delete_desc: The project and its files are removed. This cannot be undone.
ui_preview_toast_saved_desc: Everyone in the workspace sees the new version.
ui_preview_alert_desc: Exports run in the background and arrive by email.
ui_preview_alert_error_desc: Update the card on file to keep the workspace active.
ui_preview_name_too_short: The name needs at least 2 characters.
ui_preview_dialog_desc_overlays: Popovers hold light, non-modal content next to their trigger; sheets slide in from an edge (the bottom sheet is the phone version of a popover).
ui_preview_popover_body: Atlas uses 2.4 GB of 10 GB. Older exports are removed after 30 days.
ui_preview_sheet_body: Anyone in the workspace can view Atlas. Invite people to let them edit.
